title_en: Doctors and Pharmacies (3/20): Uncle Wang's Blood Sugar
note_en: One sentence here nests two paired connectors: 糖尿病虽然不能完全治好，但是只要控制好饮食和运动，血糖就能保持正常 "although diabetes can't be completely cured, as long as you manage your diet and exercise, your blood sugar can stay normal." English usually drops "but" after "although"; Chinese keeps both 虽然 and 但是, and pairs 只要 ("as long as") with 就 in the result.
